label: GP
description: Games played (minutes > 0).

label: MIN / game
description: Minutes per game played.

label: PTS / game
description: Points per game played.

label: REB / game
description: Rebounds per game played.

label: AST / game
description: Assists per game played.

label: STL / game
description: Steals per game played.

label: BLK / game
description: Blocks per game played.

label: TOV / game
description: Turnovers per game played.

label: FD / game
description: Fouls drawn per game played.

label: PF / game
description: Personal fouls per game played.

label: PTS / 100 poss
description: Points per 100 team offensive possessions while the player is on court.

label: AST / 100 poss
description: Assists per 100 team offensive possessions while on court.

label: TOV / 100 poss
description: Turnovers per 100 team offensive possessions while on court.

label: OREB / 100 poss
description: Offensive rebounds per 100 team offensive possessions while on court.

label: FD / 100 poss
description: Fouls drawn per 100 team offensive possessions while on court.

label: STL / 100 poss
description: Steals per 100 team defensive possessions while on court.

label: BLK / 100 poss
description: Blocks per 100 team defensive possessions while on court.

label: DREB / 100 poss
description: Defensive rebounds per 100 team defensive possessions while on court.

label: REB / 100 poss
description: Total rebounds x200 / (offensive + defensive possessions on court): combines both phases, so it uses the average of the two.

label: USG%
description: Share of the team's shot attempts and turnovers, while on court, that the player used.

label: TOV%
description: Turnovers as a share of the player's own possessions used (shot attempts + free-throw trips + turnovers).

label: OREB%
description: Share of the offensive rebounds available while on court (own team OREB + opponent DREB) that the player took.

label: DREB%
description: Share of the defensive rebounds available while on court (own team DREB + opponent OREB) that the player took.

label: GS
description: Games started.

label: OREB / game
description: Offensive rebounds per game played.

label: DREB / game
description: Defensive rebounds per game played.

label: 3PM / game
description: Three-pointers made per game played.

label: 3PA / game
description: Three-point attempts per game played.

label: FTA / game
description: Free-throw attempts per game played.

label: 3PM / 100 poss
description: Three-pointers made per 100 team offensive possessions while on court.

label: 3PA / 100 poss
description: Three-point attempts per 100 team offensive possessions while on court.

label: FTA / 100 poss
description: Free-throw attempts per 100 team offensive possessions while on court.

label: PF / 100 poss
description: Personal fouls per 100 team defensive possessions while on court.

label: AST%
description: Share of team field goals made while on court (excluding his own) that the player assisted.

label: BLK%
description: Blocks as a share of opponent two-point attempts while on court.

label: eFG%
description: Effective field-goal percentage: (2P made + 1.5 x 3P made) / field-goal attempts.

label: 2FG%
description: Two-point field-goal percentage.

label: 3FG%
description: Three-point field-goal percentage.

label: FT%
description: Free-throw percentage.

label: FTr
description: Free-throw rate: free-throw attempts per field-goal attempt, x100.

label: 3PA / FGA
description: Share of field-goal attempts that are three-pointers.

label: TS%
description: True shooting: points / (2 x (FGA + 0.44 x FTA)).

label: PIR / game
description: Performance Index Rating per game: points, rebounds, assists, steals, blocks and fouls drawn minus misses, turnovers, fouls and blocks against.

label: PIR / min
description: PIR per minute played (total PIR / total minutes).

label: Non-scoring PIR / game
description: Everything that is not scoring: rebounds, assists, steals, blocks, fouls drawn minus fouls, blocks against and turnovers, per game.

label: Non-scoring PIR / min
description: Non-scoring PIR per minute played.

label: NET PIR / USG
description: Scoring-only contribution (points - misses - turnovers) per possession used (shot attempts + free-throw trips + turnovers).

label: Box Creation
description: Ben Taylor's Box Creation per 100 offensive possessions on court (AST, PTS+TOV and 3-point proficiency from window totals).

label: Offensive Load
description: Ben Taylor's Offensive Load per 100 offensive possessions on court; uses the play-by-play shot attempts instead of FGA + 0.44 x FTA.

label: cTOV%
description: Ben Taylor's creation-adjusted turnover rate: turnovers per 100 possessions divided by Offensive Load, x100.

label: Pace (poss / 40 min)
description: Possessions per 40 minutes (average of both teams' possessions).

label: ORtg
description: Points scored per 100 own possessions.

label: DRtg
description: Points allowed per 100 opponent possessions.

label: PTS / game
description: Points scored per game.

label: Opp PTS / game
description: Points allowed per game.

label: eFG%
description: Effective field-goal percentage.

label: Opp eFG%
description: Opponent effective field-goal percentage.

label: 2FG%
description: Two-point field-goal percentage.

label: Opp 2FG%
description: Opponent two-point field-goal percentage.

label: 3FG%
description: Three-point field-goal percentage.

label: Opp 3FG%
description: Opponent three-point field-goal percentage.

label: FTr
description: Free-throw attempts per field-goal attempt, x100.

label: Opp FTr
description: Opponent free-throw attempts per field-goal attempt, x100.

label: 3PA / FGA
description: Share of field-goal attempts that are three-pointers.

label: Opp 3PA / FGA
description: Share of opponent field-goal attempts that are three-pointers.

label: OREB%
description: Offensive rebounds taken / offensive rebounds available (own OREB + opponent DREB).

label: DREB%
description: Defensive rebounds taken / defensive rebounds available (own DREB + opponent OREB).

label: TOV / 100 poss
description: Own turnovers per 100 own possessions.

label: Opp TOV / 100 poss
description: Opponent turnovers per 100 opponent possessions.

label: AST / 100 poss
description: Own assists per 100 own possessions.

label: Opp AST / 100 poss
description: Opponent assists per 100 opponent possessions.

label: STL / 100 poss
description: Own steals per 100 defensive (= opponent) possessions.

label: Opp STL / 100 poss
description: Opponent steals per 100 of their defensive (= own) possessions.

label: BLK%
description: Own blocks as a share of opponent two-point attempts.

label: Opp BLK%
description: Opponent blocks as a share of own two-point attempts.

label: Opp At the rim FGA share
description: Share of opponent field-goal attempts taken at the rim.

label: Opp Corner 3PA share
description: Share of opponent field-goal attempts that are corner threes.

label: Fast break PTS / 100 poss
description: Own fast-break points per 100 own possessions.

label: Opp Fast break PTS / 100 poss
description: Opponent fast-break points per 100 opponent possessions.

label: Second chance PTS / 100 poss
description: Own second-chance points per 100 own possessions.

label: Opp Second chance PTS / 100 poss
description: Opponent second-chance points per 100 opponent possessions (categories overlap; do not add them up).

label: PTS off TO / 100 poss
description: Own points off turnovers per 100 own possessions.

label: Opp PTS off TO / 100 poss
description: Opponent points off turnovers per 100 opponent possessions.
